notes.title: Demo Update 1.4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342878/41b14d804a4f5621829bbe9b41a9568902b6de2f.png"]


Demo Update 1.4"A Requested Feature"
With this update a Highly requested feature has been added to the demo!




New Playable Character:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342878/c467ba28472cd66958e687ba82573a8bd9860cac.png"]

"Not So Auto Blob" - Added as a new playable character.


- Not So Auto Blob is a weaker character than the rest, what makes it unique? You have FULL control!  
Quality Of Life:
UI Buttons now have reduced animation time.


Bug Fixes:
Tooltip causing lag in later waves now fixed

AI jittering or not knowing what to do near walls has now been fixed.

Game freeze - Have now been partially fixed - It's recommended to play the game in Fullscreen mode in wave 20+
Known Issues:
Issues that might still be in the game - need more debugging

On later waves enemies can sometimes get stuck on walls

notes.title: Demo Update 1.3.9
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342878/41b14d804a4f5621829bbe9b41a9568902b6de2f.png"]


Demo Update 1.3.9"A Visual Representation"
With this update, both the steampage and the in game menus have received an updated visual coverart. 


Balance Changes:
Greedy Blob now starts with a "Blob Orb guaranteed to grant +1 gold on enemy death buff"

The boss now deals flat damage instead of player maxhealth percentage based damage

It was not communicated in any way that the boss dealt damage based on the players max health. And a player choosing max hp enchantments would thus be punished for their choices. This have now been changed!

Gold pickup radius now increased!
Quality Of Life:
The Trashbin now shows the selling price of the upgrade you hold

Globs dropped auto collect after 5 seconds


Bug Fixes:
Fixed visual bug with 4+ digit healthbar

Fixed Reroll abuse and showing wrong price

Fixed a bug that allowed you to pause the game and collect coins when paused

Fixed so the game actually pauses during the boss cutscene

Fixed a visual shield total block bug that displayed the wrong values.

Improved Blob Beam Performance - Should now cause less lag in later waves

Improved Blob Aura tier 3 Performance - Should now cause less lag in later waves

(hopefully) Fixed a bug when tabbing out and in to the game mid Game save causing the game to freeze / crash.
Known Issues:
Issues that might still be in the game - need more debugging

Alt + Tab causing game to freeze crash - more common on dual screen setups?

On later waves enemies can sometimes get stuck on walls

Speed blob + ranged / beams can sometimes get stuck when surrounded by enemies - More likely to happened the more speed the character have
